depicts: Trip planner app showing a large Leaflet street map of Fort Collins and the Colorado State University area, with zoom controls and a green list button at lower right.
text_readable: "T22 2 EAZY"; street names such as "West Mulberry Street", "West Prospect Road", "South College Avenue", "US 287". Smaller street names are tiny at native size.
